title: Weather Source Comparison: NWS vs OpenWeatherMap

targets.rawSql: WITH nws AS (SELECT AVG(value) as temp FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-observations/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'temperature' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)), owm AS (SELECT AVG(value) as temp FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-weather/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'temperature' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)) SELECT (nws.temp - owm.temp) as value FROM nws, owm

WITH nws AS (SELECT AVG(value) as wind FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-observations/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'wind_speed' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)), owm AS (SELECT AVG(value * 3.6) as wind FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-weather/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'wind_speed' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)) SELECT (nws.wind - owm.wind) as value FROM nws, owm

WITH nws AS (SELECT AVG(value) as humidity FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-observations/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'relative_humidity' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)), owm AS (SELECT AVG(value) as humidity FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-weather/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'humidity' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)) SELECT (nws.humidity - owm.humidity) as value FROM nws, owm

WITH nws AS (SELECT AVG(value/100) as pressure FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-observations/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'barometric_pressure' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)), owm AS (SELECT AVG(value) as pressure FROM (SELECT value FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-weather/**/*.parquet') WHERE metric = 'pressure' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 100)) SELECT (nws.pressure - owm.pressure) as value FROM nws, owm

WITH nws AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'temperature' THEN value END) as temp FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-observations/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1), owm AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'temperature' THEN value END) as temp FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-weather/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(n.bucket, o.bucket) as time, n.temp as "NWS Temperature", o.temp as "OpenWeatherMap Temperature" FROM nws n FULL OUTER JOIN owm o ON n.bucket = o.bucket ORDER BY time

WITH nws AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'wind_speed' THEN value END) as wind FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-observations/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1), owm AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'wind_speed' THEN value * 3.6 END) as wind FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-weather/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(n.bucket, o.bucket) as time, n.wind as "NWS Wind Speed", o.wind as "OpenWeatherMap Wind Speed" FROM nws n FULL OUTER JOIN owm o ON n.bucket = o.bucket ORDER BY time

WITH nws AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'relative_humidity' THEN value END) as humidity FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-observations/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1), owm AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'humidity' THEN value END) as humidity FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-weather/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(n.bucket, o.bucket) as time, n.humidity as "NWS Humidity", o.humidity as "OpenWeatherMap Humidity" FROM nws n FULL OUTER JOIN owm o ON n.bucket = o.bucket ORDER BY time

WITH nws AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'barometric_pressure' THEN value / 100 END) as pressure FROM read_parquet('/data/data/nws-observations/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1), owm AS (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', to_timestamp(timestamp/1000000)) as bucket, AVG(CASE WHEN metric = 'pressure' THEN value END) as pressure FROM read_parquet('/data/data/outdoor-weather/**/*.parquet') WHERE timestamp >= ${__from}::BIGINT * 1000 AND timestamp <= ${__to}::BIGINT * 1000 GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(n.bucket, o.bucket) as time, n.pressure as "NWS Pressure", o.pressure as "OpenWeatherMap Pressure" FROM nws n FULL OUTER JOIN owm o ON n.bucket = o.bucket ORDER BY time
